steps: Printful is already connected to the store (since 29 Oct), and most variants look linked: they are stocked at the Printful location and sit in Printful's own shipping profiles. Shopify can't show which product, colour, file or placement each link uses, so check each one in Printful against its card here.
In Printful, open Stores and check the store shows as connected. In the store's settings, turn on "Manually confirm all imported orders" until every link is checked and the samples are approved.
Press "Refresh data". Each variant shows Synced, Not synced or Ignored.

Open a listing and go through its variants. For each one, compare the product, colour, size, technique, placement, file, width, position and threads with its card here. Fix anything that differs: Edit, then Choose product.
Link any variant that is "Not synced" the same way.
Check the threads every time. The embroidery files here use Printful's own thread colours, so its colour match should land on the right ones; on brand-colour files it picks Navy and Red.
"Apply to other variants" only inside one card. Never across hat styles, and never between Embroidered and Printed.
Don't let Printful push mockups or product text to Shopify: the photos and words on the store are yours.
Leave the stock alone: the 9,999 at the Printful location is how Printful marks a linked variant.
Tick each card when it's checked. Then order samples and sew-outs, and only then turn manual confirmation off.
fileRules: Upload the PNG the card gives you. Embroidery: the 600 dpi file in Printful's thread colours. Print: the 300 dpi file in brand colours. Both are true size with a transparent background.
Set the width in inches from the card. Never resize an embroidery file to another size: each size is its own drawing. Print files can scale.
Printful digitizes the PNG itself; no stitch file needed. Up to 6 threads per placement, flat colours only.
Printful's minimums: text 6.35 mm tall, lines 1.27 mm; shapes closer than about 3 mm may merge. The logo's and clock's finest parts are under that: sew-out first.
3D puff: hat fronts only (catalogue copies also list the Cuffed Beanie; the RIO is disputed). Lines 5 to 12.5 mm, gaps at least 1.27 mm, and no flat stitching in the same placement.

Areas: 6245CM front 5.5 x 2 in; 6606 front 5.9 x 2 in; 31-069 front 6.3 x 2.55 in; hat side or back 2 x 1 in; beanie cuff 5 x 1.75 in; left or centre chest 4 x 4 in; sleeve 2 x 3 in; large front, centre or back 10 x 6 in. Each product's File guidelines tab has the final word.

decisions: Shipping

Printful made its own shipping profiles with its own flat rates, and most variants now sit in them instead of your profile (C$12, free over C$75). Keep Printful's rates, or move the variants back and add the Printful location to your profile? Then test a checkout to Canada and to the US.
Coming soon
Ours to Spend. and 5:00 are live and can be bought, but their descriptions say "Coming soon" and there is no art for them. Hide them until the art exists?
Puff or flat

The listings promise 3D puff on the Logo Hat (~125 mm), every beanie and bucket hat, and For a Reason. The ready art is flat. Puff needs bigger, heavier drawings, and a shifted 125 mm logo won't fit the Dad Hat. Change the text to flat embroidery, or have puff versions drawn.
Printed versions

Six listings sell a printed version next to the embroidered one (the Logo, Clock and Punched Out. hoodies, Nowhere To Be., Not Picking Up. and the golf shirt). picks.md says everything embroidered, with The Rest Is Ours. back as the only print. Keep both?
Front logos
The Rest Is Ours.: front logo printed (the listing) or embroidered (picks.md)? Pocket tees: printed on the pocket (the listing), or the clock on the sleeve and the logo big on the front (picks.md)?
Hoodie fronts

Punched Out. Hoodie, Oversized Embroidered: this sheet uses the big front (picks.md); the listing says a small chest piece. Not Picking Up., Oversized Embroidered: the two-line stack isn't drawn; use the one line on the big front, or have the stack drawn.
Golf shirt

The printed version adds a logo below the back collar, which isn't in picks.md. Printful's spot for it and the distance from the collar aren't confirmed. SOL'S may be made in Latvia only; the Adidas A430 embroiders poorly.
Missing art

Time Well Earned., The Rest Is Ours. back, Ours to Spend., 5:00 (wider than a chest spot) and For a Reason. were made outside this repo: their files need to come from whoever made them. Puff versions don't exist yet either.
Colours to pick
Sun's Still Up., Banked Time. and Parked. have no colour option. Their mockups show dark caps (dark files); the light files are ready too.
Sizes not set
Punched Out. Hat, Crewneck and Jacket; the sweatpants leg logo; the pocket prints; the big-front heights; back distances from the collar.
Swatches
Beige, Blue Jean, Espresso, Caramel, Blue Spruce, Pine Green and Smoke sit between light and dark. Check a swatch before samples: if the gold hands vanish, use the Bone one-colour file.
Sew-outs
The logo's hand tips (0.58 mm) and channel (1.0 mm) and the 25 mm clock's tips (~0.72 mm) are under Printful's 1.27 mm minimum. Sew-outs before going live; spending is your call.
Trademarks

Before samples: POWER PUNCHOUT (US Reg. 5079893), NOWHERE TO BE (85784193), TIME WELL SPENT (Reg. 3252699), HERE FOR A REASON (SN 98183164); and searches for SUN'S STILL UP, NO ALARM SET, BANKED TIME, NOT PICKING UP and PARKED. Keep 5:00 without "somewhere".

The store prices were set before Printful's embroidered prices, extra placements (+US$2.95) and digitizing (US$6.50 a design). Check the margins in C$ with the region set to Canada.
